SobrePage.seoTitle: About Vem Passear em Jampa | Who's behind the tours in João Pessoa
SobrePage.seoDescription: Vem Passear em Jampa is a receptive tourism agency in João Pessoa with active Cadastur. Direct service with Murillo on WhatsApp, no impersonal call center.
SobrePage.ogDescription: Receptive agency in João Pessoa with active Cadastur. Direct service with Murillo on WhatsApp.
SobrePage.heroTitulo: Vem Passear em Jampa — receptive agency in João Pessoa
SobrePage.heroSubtitulo: Local operation, direct WhatsApp service and itinerary organized without middlemen. Murillo personally replies to anyone looking for tour information in João Pessoa.
SobrePage.marcaTitulo: Direct service from someone who loves to travel and knows the Northeast
SobrePage.marcaP1: Vem Passear em Jampa was born from Affonso Murillo Soledade de Oliveira's passion — known as Murillo — for travel, for the Northeast and for João Pessoa.
SobrePage.marcaP2: A former athlete, traveler and passionate about discovering new places, Murillo carries a strong relationship with the Northeast. After many travel experiences and visiting different destinations, he decided to turn that passion into an agency made to help others experience João Pessoa with more peace of mind, safety and guidance.
SobrePage.marcaP3: That's how Vem Passear em Jampa was born: a tour agency created to connect tourists to Paraíba's best itineraries, always with human service, trusted partners and care in every detail of the experience.
SobrePage.marcaP4: Here, service is direct. The one talking to you on WhatsApp is Murillo himself, understanding your profile, dates, budget and the kind of tour that makes the most sense for your trip.
SobrePage.marcaQuote: The agency's foundation is simple: partnership, fair pricing, quality and trust.
SobrePage.marcaP5: That's why Vem Passear em Jampa works with licensed local operators and selected partners, aiming to offer organized, safe and well-guided tours — for families, couples, groups or first-time visitors to João Pessoa.
SobrePage.marcaP6: More than selling tours, Vem Passear em Jampa's mission is to help each customer choose the right itinerary, at the best moment of the trip, with the peace of mind of being in good hands.
SobrePage.marcaP7: If you want to discover João Pessoa with someone who loves to travel, knows the Northeast and values an experience made with responsibility, Vem Passear em Jampa is ready to welcome you.

faq.pergunta: Is Vem Passear em Jampa a registered agency?
faq.resposta: Yes. Registered with Cadastur (Brazil's Ministry of Tourism) under nº 52.077.577. We operate in accordance with Brazilian tourism law and meet all the safety and service requirements for inbound travel agencies.

faq.pergunta: How does the service work? Is there an impersonal call center?
faq.resposta: You talk directly with Murillo on WhatsApp — no call center, no middleman. Murillo lives in João Pessoa, organizes the tours, follows every booking, and answers your questions before, during, and after the tour.

faq.pergunta: Are guides and drivers accredited?
faq.resposta: Yes. All tour drivers and guides are accredited as required by Brazilian tourism law. We only work with partners with proper documentation and real local knowledge.

faq.pergunta: Do you offer service in other languages?
faq.resposta: The website is in Portuguese, English, and Spanish. WhatsApp service is mainly in Portuguese, with basic English and Spanish support for international travelers. For private tours requiring a bilingual guide, check availability.

faq.pergunta: How do you select your partners (catamarans, drivers, restaurants)?
faq.resposta: We work with partners we know personally, who have been around for years, with compliant vessels and human service. Google reputation matters, but the real test is our own customer: if anyone comes back complaining, we don't repeat that partner.

faq.pergunta: Can you share contacts of past clients to check?
faq.resposta: Yes. We have 68 real Google reviews (4.9/5 stars) you can read right now, and Murillo shares client references directly on WhatsApp if you prefer to talk to someone who has traveled with us.

faq.pergunta: How do I book a tour?
faq.resposta: On WhatsApp — it's the direct channel with Murillo. Send a message with the tour you want, the date and number of people. He checks availability, confirms tide (when needed) and gives you payment instructions. Simple as that, no form, no middlemen.

faq.pergunta: What payment methods are accepted?
faq.resposta: We accept credit and debit cards. Installments are possible, but the fee is on the customer — number of installments and platform are confirmed at the time of payment. Any doubts, just ask on WhatsApp before booking.

faq.pergunta: Do children pay? Is there a discount for children?
faq.resposta: Children under 5 don't pay. 5 to 11 years old: 20% discount off the adult rate. From 12 years old: adult rate. ATV tours have a minimum age of 7 — confirm on WhatsApp before booking.

faq.pergunta: What happens if it rains on the day of the tour?
faq.resposta: Light rain doesn't cancel — João Pessoa has fast-changing weather and the tour goes on normally. If there's heavy rain or bad sea conditions, the tour doesn't run. In that case, you get notice at least 2 hours in advance and can reschedule at no extra cost. If rescheduling isn't possible: 100% refund.

faq.pergunta: What's the cancellation policy?
faq.resposta: Cancellation more than 24 hours in advance: free rescheduling. No-show or last-minute cancellation: no refund. If the tour is cancelled by the operator due to weather or tide conditions: free rescheduling or full refund. Specific questions, ask on WhatsApp.

faq.pergunta: What's a tide table and how does it affect my tour?
faq.resposta: The tide table is the Brazilian Navy's official calendar showing low and high tide times every day. Natural-pool tours (Seixas, Picãozinho, Areia Vermelha) depend on low tide to work. Before confirming your booking, Murillo checks if the day has suitable tide conditions — you never book without that confirmation.

faq.pergunta: Are the tours safe? Are there life vests?
faq.resposta: Yes. Life vests are available onboard throughout the tour — recommended for non-swimmers and children. Vem Passear em Jampa has active Cadastur (number 52.077.577). The operation follows maritime safety standards and tours are led by licensed, trained professionals.

faq.pergunta: Is it possible to do a private tour (just for my group)?
faq.resposta: Yes — all tours have a private option. In private mode, only your group goes on the tour. The price depends on the tour, date and number of people — never a fixed price, always quoted case by case. Send a message on WhatsApp with the group details and Murillo will give you the option.

faq.pergunta: Does Vem Passear have official registration with the Ministry of Tourism?
faq.resposta: Yes. CNPJ 52.077.577/0001-03, Cadastur number 52.077.577 — valid until 12/16/2026. You can verify the registration on the Ministry of Tourism's official website at any time.

faq.pergunta: Where can I see real customer reviews?
faq.resposta: On Google — Vem Passear em Jampa has a 4.9/5 rating with 68 reviews from real customers. Murillo can send the direct review link on WhatsApp if you prefer to check before booking.

faq.pergunta: I can't swim. Can I do the natural-pool tours?
faq.resposta: Yes. Most natural pools have shallow water — you can stand or use a life vest. The guide stays close throughout the tour. Many people who've never swum do the tour with no problem. If you have a question about a specific tour, just ask on WhatsApp.

faq.pergunta: Does the tour include hotel transfer?
faq.resposta: It depends on the tour. Most include transfer to departure points in Tambaú, Cabo Branco, Manaíra and Bessa. For other neighborhoods or hotels outside these points, check availability on WhatsApp. Vem Passear also offers separate 24h transfer to the airport and any point in the city.

TransferPage.faqTitulo: Frequently asked questions about the Transfer

faq.pergunta: How do I request a quote?
faq.resposta: Via WhatsApp. Send the pickup point, destination, date, desired time, and number of passengers. We confirm the per-trip rate and availability immediately.

faq.pergunta: Is the transfer charged per person or per trip?
faq.resposta: Per trip. The price is a single fare per ride — regardless of 1, 2, or 4 passengers (within vehicle capacity). No extra charge per additional passenger.

faq.pergunta: Do you handle night and early morning flights?
faq.resposta: Yes. Our transfer runs 24/7, including overnight flights, weekends, and holidays. Let us know the flight time at booking.

faq.pergunta: What if my flight is delayed?
faq.resposta: We track the flight status. If there's a delay, the driver adjusts and waits. You don't pay extra — flight monitoring is included in the per-trip rate.

faq.pergunta: Can I book a transfer to any point in João Pessoa?
faq.resposta: Yes. Airport, hotels, Airbnb, restaurants, tour boarding points, bus station — we cover any point in the city. Nearby cities (Cabedelo, Conde): ask for the rate on WhatsApp.

faq.pergunta: How many passengers fit in the vehicle?
faq.resposta: Standard vehicle seats up to 4 passengers with luggage. For larger groups (5+), let us know at booking — we have executive vehicles or vans available. Rate on request.

faq.pergunta: How do I pay for the transfer?
faq.resposta: Payment via PIX or card (credit/debit). Confirmation happens via WhatsApp before the trip. No extra charge beyond the quoted rate.

faq.pergunta: Does Vem Passear handle closed excursions coming from other cities?
faq.resposta: Yes. We handle the João Pessoa side — itinerary, local transport, guides, on-site support. You can arrive with your own bus from origin or hire transport with us from the airport, bus station or hotel.

faq.pergunta: Do you provide the bus or work with the transport the group already has?
faq.resposta: Both options. If you're coming with a bus from the origin city, we operate only the itinerary and on-site support. If you need transport in João Pessoa, we book with accredited operational partners — capacity and format are confirmed in the proposal, according to group size.

faq.pergunta: Is there a discount for a large group?
faq.resposta: We don't have a fixed discount table. What exists is a special condition assessed case by case from 4 people on — depends on group size, dates, combination of tours. Worth asking in the briefing.

faq.pergunta: Do you handle meals, lodging or just the tour itinerary?
faq.resposta: Itinerary, transport and on-site support are the focus. Lodging and restaurants: we recommend trusted partners for groups, but the contract is yours. Anyone who's organized a group knows that mixing everything into one bill creates more problems than it solves.

faq.pergunta: Can I build a 100% custom itinerary or only the pre-built ones?
faq.resposta: 100% custom. The page templates are starting points, not closed packages. The real proposal is built after the briefing.

faq.pergunta: How do you handle a fixed date that catches a bad tide?
faq.resposta: For natural-pool tours (Seixas, Picãozinho, Areia Vermelha), Murillo checks the tide table before accepting the date. If there's no good tide window on the day the group has already booked, we adjust the itinerary: switch to a tour that doesn't depend on tide (city tour, south coast, sunset, catamaran at high tide) or suggest another time on the same day. You never get here and discover the tour can't go out.

faq.pergunta: How many departures are there in May 2026 for the natural pools?
faq.resposta: In May 2026, there are 18 days with confirmed departure for the natural pools — divided into 3 tide cycles. The best days are between May 13 and 20, when the tide reaches excellent conditions (below 0.5m), with highlights on 05/16, 17 and 18 with historic 0.2m tide (syzygy).

faq.pergunta: Why do natural-pool tours depend on the tide?
faq.resposta: The natural pools at Seixas, Picãozinho and Areia Vermelha only appear at low tide. With water above 0.8m, access is compromised. That's why tours only run on certain days of the month, always in the morning's low-tide window.

faq.pergunta: What does tide 'excellent', 'good' and 'check' mean?
faq.resposta: Excellent (0.0–0.5m): pools well exposed, complete experience. Good (0.6–0.7m): pools accessible with good visibility. Check (0.8m): reduced conditions — verify with Murillo before booking. No tour (above 0.9m): pools submerged, tour not run.

faq.pergunta: Can I book a specific date on the calendar?
faq.resposta: Yes. Choose the desired date on the calendar and contact Murillo on WhatsApp. He confirms availability, the exact departure time and the meeting point. Departures leave from Tambaú, João Pessoa.

faq.pergunta: Is the calendar data official from the Navy?
faq.resposta: The times are based on the Cabedelo/PB Port tide table and reviewed by Murillo before each publication. Small variations may occur — always confirm the final time on WhatsApp the day before the tour.

faq.pergunta: What's the best tide for natural pools in João Pessoa?
faq.resposta: The best condition is very low tide — the lower it is, the more coral pool is exposed and the calmer the snorkeling. Generally, heights close to 0.5m or less make for prettier tours. The height varies daily, so check the table before booking.

faq.pergunta: Which tours depend on low tide?
faq.resposta: The three main ones are: Seixas Natural Pools, Picãozinho and Areia Vermelha. Other João Pessoa coast tours — Sunset at Jacaré, Classic South Coast, City Tour — don't depend on tide and run every day.

faq.pergunta: Does Areia Vermelha go out every day?
faq.resposta: No. Areia Vermelha is a sandbar in Cabedelo that only appears at low tide. Some weeks have several consecutive departure days; others have none. So it's best to check the table and confirm with me on WhatsApp before booking.

faq.pergunta: Does Picãozinho depend on the tide?
faq.resposta: Yes. Picãozinho is a set of natural pools about 1.5 km from Tambaú beach, and only safe for swimming and snorkeling at low tide. When the tide rises, the pools disappear.

faq.pergunta: Do Seixas Natural Pools depend on the tide?
faq.resposta: Yes. Seixas Pools are at the easternmost point of the American continent and only visitable at low tide. When the tide is high, the area is covered and the tour doesn't happen.

faq.pergunta: How do I know the best day to book?
faq.resposta: Check the table on this page for a general reference and reach out on WhatsApp with your travel date. I'll confirm if the tide is favorable and recommend the best tour for your day.

faq.pergunta: Can I book a natural-pool tour without checking the tide table?
faq.resposta: You can message even without checking — I'll cross-reference your date with the tide and guide you. But if you've already checked and have date flexibility, it's easier to pick a window with good tide.

faq.pergunta: What to do in João Pessoa when the tide is high?
faq.resposta: Plenty. The South Coast (Coqueirinho, Tambaba, Praia Bela) doesn't depend on the tide — you can go any day. The Sunset at Jacaré, in Cabedelo, happens every evening regardless of the tide. The City Tour of João Pessoa's historic centre is also available every day. Message me on WhatsApp and I'll put together the right itinerary for your day.

faq.pergunta: What is the best month for natural pools in João Pessoa?
faq.resposta: The months with the most trips are between March and September, a period of stronger spring tides and less rain. In 2026, May and June have the longest windows of low tide — especially on spring tide days (full and new moon), when the tide reaches 0.2–0.3m. But every month has good days; what changes is the frequency. Check the table on this page or send me your travel date on WhatsApp and I'll advise.
